lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid of vertical and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the most defined clusters occurring along the mid-lateral line and becoming more diffuse towards the ventral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the primary spot centroids, particularly evident in the mid-flank region where they create a distinct checkerboard-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the mid-flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with highlights on the superior surface and distinct shadowing on the inferior surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least three remoras (suckerfish) positioned ventrally and posterior to the left pectoral fin.
